observations: PR 282 closes local-source usability but intentionally leaves remote observation unproven.
The existing context-observation format already supplies immutable commit/blob, request/receipt identity, digest, and max-age primitives but is coupled to an already frozen Execute request.
The missing bridge is a pre-semantic observation handshake bound to the current Work authority and exact local blob.
